study type: Population-based twin study with cross-sectional analysis
cohort: The study included 850 monozygotic and 2279 like-sex dizygotic twin pairs, 3-9 years of age, from the Danish Twin Registry.
finding: Prematurity, Cesarean section, and maternal smoking during pregnancy significantly increased the risk of asthma, but none of the early-life factors were associated with atopic dermatitis or hay fever, and there was no evidence of genetic effect modification on atopic diseases.
mod_finding: Cesarean section significantly influenced the risk of asthma (OR = 1.25, CI = 1.05-1.49).
cross-section timing: When children were 3-9 years of age
